profile.headline: Senior Security Software Engineer at Bridgewater Associates
profile.summary:
Building AI-driven cybersecurity analytics at the intersection of engineering and data science.

Senior Software Engineer and Data Scientist with 8+ years of experience building production-grade AI/ML systems and data platforms for cybersecurity and analytics. I specialize in taking ambiguous, high-stakes problems—risk detection, behavioral signals, threat insights, and operational intelligence—and turning them into scalable services, pipelines, and products that teams can trust.

My work spans full-stack engineering, data engineering, MLOps, and applied NLP and behavioral analytics, from feature-rich APIs and dashboards to streaming enrichment, model evaluation, and large-scale search and observability platforms. I’m known for pragmatic execution, clean architecture, and delivering solutions that measurably reduce risk and improve decision-making speed.

I’m also the author of Notation of Being, an exploration of how humans compress complexity into systems of meaning. That perspective influences how I design software: clear frames, honest metrics, and tools that help people focus on what matters most.

positions.title: Capstone Senior Design - Texas A&M University
positions.description: Capstone Senior Design project sponsored by Lockheed Martin.  Designed and built an autonomous rescue drone.  The drone used a DJI  quadcopter base with a arduino, raspberry pi, and flight microcontroller.  We implemneted sensor fusion between ultrasonic, flir vission, camera, and 360 lidar sensors to autonomosly navitage indoor spaces and detect humans inside.  The data was collected and in real time sent to a laptop station where it is process and to provide a layout of the building in real time to the rescue operators as well as pinpoint and mark on the map the locations of high confidence human presence. (C++, Python, Javascript)

positions.title: Security Solutions Engineer - Intern
positions.description: Worked as a Tier-1 Security Analyst/ Security Solutions  Engineer Intern in the Security Operations Center (SOC) under Cisco's Managed Security Services.  This included investigating security events, determining severity of events based on telemetry, indicators of attack and indicators of compromise, as well as researching active threat intelligence from various domains.  I also had the opportunity to work on various projects involving data validation and aggregation, improving the efficiency of the SOC workflow and researching as well as mapping technology solutions according to MITRE's CAPEC Attack Domains.

positions.title: IT Security & Network Systems Design Engineer - Intern
positions.description: Implemented an enterprise grade SDN controller.  Designed and implemented an automated and orchestrated process for provisioning new infrastructure devices.  I also worked with PKI architecture, certificate enrollment, VPN architecture, REST APIs, and was able to gain valuable experience pen-testing using Kali-Linux.
